tasks.question: A county must pick one primary evacuation hub before sundown. Public briefings emphasize West Pier (fast ferry capacity) and Canyon Mall (indoor space). North Ridge Campground is listed as a backup with 'limited amenities'. Which hub should be designated the primary evacuation site?

clues.text: Harbor authority radar shows West Pier ferry channel will be closed for dredging from 17:00; no waiver issued.
Fire ops map: only access road to Canyon Mall is within the current flame front polygon; convoys were turned back at mile 4.
Red Cross logistics: North Ridge has potable water hookups, generator fuel delivery confirmed, and is outside the smoke AQI threshold for sensitive groups.

tasks.question: Pharma ops must lock one investigative site for a Phase II trial requiring daily cold-chain samples and 6-hour lab turnaround. Site Alpha advertises the lowest per-patient stipend. Site Beta is closest to headquarters on the org chart. Site Gamma is labeled 'remote' in the slide deck. Which site should be selected?

clues.text: Courier audit: Alpha's freezer trucks failed temperature excursion logging on two runs last month; QA flagged hold status.
Central lab SLA matrix: only Gamma's partner lab certifies 4-hour STAT processing for the biomarker panel; Beta's partner is 18-hour batch.
Regulatory memo: Alpha lacks updated IRB amendment for the new inclusion criterion; enrollment cannot start there until signed.
Travel desk: Beta principal investigator is on sabbatical through Q3; no delegate PI on file with the sponsor.

tasks.question: Mission control must choose one ground station for tonight's time-critical downlink: Station Lima (newest dish, marketing highlight), Station Kilo (legacy but 'always available' in the wiki), or Station Juliet (listed as spare). Which station should receive the pass?

clues.text: RF interference survey: Lima's band is contaminated by a nearby 5G tower on the exact downlink frequency; SNR below lock threshold.
Maintenance ticket: Kilo azimuth motor stuck at 214°; cannot track tonight's max elevation pass without manual repair (ETA 36h).
Weather cell: Juliet sits in the only clear-sky pocket along the ground track; Lima and Kilo are both under convective cloud cover at AOS.

tasks.question: Manufacturing must approve one resin supplier for medical-device housings this quarter. Vendor Prism offers 12% discount on volume. Vendor Quartz wins the internal popularity poll for responsiveness. Vendor Obsidian is the incumbent but labeled 'expensive' in the CFO slide. Which supplier should be approved?

tasks.question: A research consortium must allocate one queue for a 72-hour climate ensemble run. Cluster Aurora has the highest peak FLOPS headline. Cluster Borealis is advertised as 'green energy'. Cluster Cirrus is described as 'older but stable'. Which cluster should run the job?

clues.text: Scheduler telemetry: Aurora has 41% GPU nodes offline due to cooling failure in rack row C; effective capacity below job size.
Network team: Borealis lacks InfiniBand path to the 800TB scratch volume; staging would require 14h serial copy before first timestep.
Software stack: only Cirrus has the licensed coupler module v3.2 preinstalled; other clusters need a 2-day license server migration.
Ops on-call log: Cirrus finished three consecutive large ensembles without checkpoint corruption; Aurora last run aborted at hour 19 with silent data loss.

tasks.question: Legal must bind one cyber insurance carrier before renewal. Carrier Redwood quotes the lowest premium in the broker summary. Carrier Sequoia is recommended in the board deck for 'brand recognition'. Carrier Juniper is noted as 'niche'. Which carrier should be bound?

Juniper policy draft includes unlimited forensics hours, 24h breach coach, and matches our SOC2 scope without sublimits on SaaS dependency failures.

tasks.question: A museum must choose one shipping route for a fragile terracotta loan: Route Air (fastest transit time on the poster), Route Rail (marked 'climate controlled'), or Route Sea (cheapest in the finance appendix). Which route should be used?

clues.text: Conservator report: Air cargo hold humidity swung 30–70% RH on last three Asia lanes; exceeds loan agreement ±5% RH.
Rail manifest: dedicated climate car with active logging and museum-approved vibration dampers on the Paris–Berlin segment.
Port agent: Sea container missed two transshipment windows; cumulative dwell time would exceed insurance max of 14 days.
Customs liaison: Air route requires temporary export license waiver not yet approved; Rail route uses existing cultural-goods carnet.
